name: [HIGH] CVE-2026-53614
statusMessage: util-linux: util-linux: SUID mount(8) allows nosuid/noexec bypass via LIBMOUNT_FORCE_MOUNT2
statusTrace: A flaw was found in util-linux. The mount(8) SUID binary does not sanitize the LIBMOUNT_FORCE_MOUNT2 environment variable before use. A local unprivileged user can set this variable to force mount(8) to use the legacy two-step mount(2) code path, which applies security restrictions such as nosuid and noexec after the mount is already active. During this window, an attacker can execute a SUID binary from the mounted filesystem, allowing local privilege escalation to root.
